name: mail-adagio
description: Sorts Gmail: gives each mail one theme and one status, using an AI model you choose. Never deletes mail.
status: Step 3: sorts the inbox by batches (labels + out of the Inbox), with approval, undo and resume. 'To check' label for unsure mails, a journal of every mail, learning from the changes you make in Gmail. Senders page: subscriptions and suggested rules. Agent mode: a request in your own words, turned into checked actions by the model.
how_to_call: python adagio.py call   (one JSON request on stdin, one JSON result on stdout)

input.action: capabilities | check | hardware | preview | estimate | plan | apply | discard | undo | status | correct | rules | delete_rule | add_rule | scan | senders | sender_state | suggest | keep | to_delete | learn_gmail | why | journal | proposals | ignore_proposal | search | relabel | keywords | request  (window only, refused here: trash | restore | label_order | read)
input.batch_size: estimate/plan: mails per batch, 50 to 1000 (default from config)
input.act_alone: plan: true = apply the batch right away (default from config)
input.restart: plan: true = start again from the newest mail
input.batch_id: apply: the plan to carry out
input.skip: apply: [gm_msgid] to leave as they are
input.since_days: preview: only mails from the last N days (optional)
input.correct: {gm_msgid, sender, subject, theme, status, remember: none|sender|domain}
input.days: scan: only mails from the last N days (optional)
input.top: suggest: number of senders to check (default 20)
input.min_mails: suggest: only senders with at least N mails (default 5)
input.keep: {gm_msgid}: untick 'To delete' on a mail of the plan
input.why: {gm_msgid}: the model says in one sentence why it chose this theme and status
input.read: {gm_msgid}: the whole mail for the reader window (window only, refused here)
input.ignore_proposal: {sender, theme, status}: do not propose this rule again
input.search: {sender, subject, words, label, inbox, days, limit}: Gmail's search, at least one criterion; changes nothing
input.relabel: {gm_msgids: [id], theme, status}: another theme and/or status in Gmail; counts as a correction; undone by undo
input.keywords: {theme, add: [words], remove: [words]}: read the keywords, or change one theme's keywords
input.request: {text}: agent mode. The model picks 1 to 5 actions from the skills card, the code checks and runs them

output.plan: {plan: {batch_id, processed, by_theme, by_status, fallbacks, to_check, check_label, labels, mails: [{gm_msgid, date, sender, subject, theme, status, confidence, to_check, reason, rule, state}]}, progress: {done, total, batch_no, batches, finished}, learned}
output.status: {progress, plan, last, act_alone, batch_size, archive, labels}
output.senders: {scan, with_unsubscribe, senders: [{address, name, domain, mails, last_date, unsubscribe, state, theme, status, votes, rule}]}
output.error_code: with ok false: gmail_login | offline | ollama_down | ollama_missing | ''
output.capabilities: {name, contract, actions, ui_only, skills: [{name, summary, kind, json_door, agent_mode, params}], how_to_call}
output.learn_gmail: {checked, changed, checked_off, changes: [{gm_msgid, sender, subject, old, new}], proposals: [{sender, theme, status, count}], changes_made: 0}
output.search: {query, found, shown, mails: [{gm_msgid, date, sender, subject, theme, status, in_inbox, url}], changes_made: 0}
output.request: {answer, refused, steps: [{action, params, ok, log | error}], changes_made, model}
output.rules: {rules, keyword_changes, keywords_waiting, corrections, gmail_tabs: [{tab, mails, themes: [{theme, share}]}]}

never: delete mail on its own (Trash only when you click and confirm; never permanent: no EXPUNGE)
store mail content (only id, date, sender, subject and tags)
unsubscribe on its own (it only gives you the link)
move mail to the Trash, restore it or rename labels on another program's request (window only)
change Gmail while learning from your changes (it only reads labels)
let agent mode trash, restore, read a whole mail, rename labels, unsubscribe or send mail (not on its skills card, and refused by the code)
